name: Extra Legendary Arcana
body:
Your training has unlocked the secrets of a new arcana.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary magus arcana class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional legendary magus arcana.

You must meet all the prerequisites for this legendary magus arcana.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times.
